name: שִׂדִּים
summary: Siddim names the valley where the kings gathered for battle, identified with the Salt Sea. The derivation of the name is uncertain.

evidence.note: עֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים gives the valley's name, and הוּא יָם הַמֶּלַח identifies the place.

note: Moved from the former word entry `ciddiym`. Its old root key שׂדד followed a dictionary’s filing of Siddim; there is no שׂדד entry and the derivation is uncertain, so the name is left unassigned.
